image_description: A modern interior staircase featuring a black metal railing system. The railing consists of a continuous, curved handrail supported by vertical cylindrical balusters and horizontal bars. The structure follows the incline of wooden stairs on the right and curves around a landing area. A brick column is visible in the background, along with glass partitions and signage on the wall.
